beaches.name: Park Point Beach House
beaches.coordinateNote: Park Point Beach House shoreline reference, approximate; not a parking pin
beaches.story: At Park Point, the city gives way to a long ribbon of sand between Duluth Harbor and Lake Superior. Wind off the open lake can feel strikingly different from sheltered streets.

safety.name: Minnesota Lake Superior Beach Monitoring Program

beaches.name: Big Bay State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: Approximate park shore reference; not a ferry dock or entrance
beaches.story: Madeline Island's sandstone shore opens to Lake Superior. The beach and wooded boardwalk offer very different shelter from wind, even within a short walk.
beaches.accessAlert: The park reports construction closures affecting the beach parking lot from September 8, 2026 through approximately June 30, 2027. Check current park conditions before travel.

beaches.name: Kohler-Andrae State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: Approximate lakefront reference, not an exact swim-area entrance
beaches.story: Wooded trails and dune grasses give way to a long, open sweep of Lake Michigan. A breeze that barely stirs the pines may be more noticeable on the sand.

beaches.name: Point Beach State Forest
beaches.coordinateNote: Park-level reference, not an exact swim-area entrance
beaches.story: Six miles of beach edge the forest. Where trees stop and open water begins, the breeze and the sounds of Lake Michigan become the weather story.

beaches.name: North Avenue Beach
beaches.coordinateNote: Illinois BeachGuard beach-center coordinate, not a parking pin
beaches.story: The city skyline rises behind the sand, but the lake sets its own pace. A lake breeze can cool an exposed walk after a warm afternoon inland.

beaches.name: Illinois Beach State Park North Beach
beaches.coordinateNote: Illinois BeachGuard beach-center coordinate, not a trailhead
beaches.story: This rare stretch of natural Illinois lakefront carries dunes, wetland habitat and wide views over Lake Michigan. Leave the tree line and pay attention to the wind.

beaches.name: West Beach, Indiana Dunes National Park
beaches.coordinateNote: Indiana water-quality monitoring coordinate; the visitor entrance is elsewhere
beaches.story: Climb toward the dunes and you can see how much shoreline the lake controls. The open beach is less sheltered than the woods and stairs behind it.

beaches.name: Indiana Dunes State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: Indiana beach-monitoring station coordinate, not a parking pin
beaches.story: Dune ridges rise beyond a wide sandy strand. Wind crossing Lake Michigan meets a landscape of exposed shore, protected hollows and forest.

beaches.name: Edgewater Beach
beaches.coordinateNote: USGS shoreline monitoring coordinate; not an entrance
beaches.story: Just beyond Cleveland's streets, the beach faces a broad stretch of Lake Erie. The open water and exposed sand can change how a day feels without changing the city forecast.

beaches.name: Maumee Bay State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: USGS park-water reference east of marina, not a beach entry or monitored swim-area pin
beaches.story: Here Lake Erie meets marsh, meadow and shore. The western basin is shallow, and the experience may change quickly as clouds and wind pass across the bay.

beaches.name: Presque Isle State Park, Beach 6
beaches.coordinateNote: USGS Beach 6 East monitoring reference; not a lifeguard or parking location
beaches.story: On Presque Isle's sandy peninsula, Lake Erie is always close. The breeze you feel beyond the dunes may differ from conditions back in Erie.
beaches.accessAlert: Swimming is permitted only at designated guarded areas when officially open. Check current staffed beaches and posted restrictions.

beaches.name: Evangola State Park Beach
beaches.coordinateNote: New York State beach-program monitoring coordinate, not entrance
beaches.story: A broad sandy shore runs beneath the Lake Erie sky. Notice what the wind is doing over open water before settling in for the afternoon.

safety.name: New York Coastal Beach Water Quality

beaches.name: Woodlawn Beach State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: New York beach-program monitoring coordinate, not entrance
beaches.story: Near the eastern end of Lake Erie, the shore opens into sky and sand. A steady lake wind can make the air feel different than it does a few streets back.

safety.name: New York Coastal Beach Water Quality

beaches.name: Hamlin Beach State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: New York beach-monitoring reference, not precise parking location
beaches.story: Lake Ontario stretches north from these broad beaches. A clear inland morning is only part of the story; the open water and the afternoon breeze matter here.

safety.name: New York Coastal Beach Water Quality

beaches.name: Fair Haven Beach State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: New York beach-monitoring reference; not a trail entrance
beaches.story: High bluffs and sandy shoreline share a small corner of Lake Ontario. At water level you meet a different wind exposure than on paths above the beach.

safety.name: New York Coastal Beach Water Quality

beaches.name: Southwick Beach State Park
beaches.coordinateNote: New York beach-monitoring reference; not an entrance
beaches.story: Dunes, marshland and a long sand beach line the eastern shore of Lake Ontario. At the lake edge, wind and cloud cover change the rhythm of a visit.
beaches.accessAlert: Consult the park for current parking, beach access and any seasonal notices.

safety.name: New York Coastal Beach Water Quality
